content.text: The full replayer matches an independently written naive reference on 500 randomized scenarios (up to 60 packets each), including final drain statuses and exact macro-F1 fractions. Next I’m checking malformed-input handling and worst-shape runtime/memory behavior.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,random
r=random.Random(9384)
C=8;E=4;W=16;K=5;F=8
cfg={'slots':256,'window':W,'idle_timeout':10**12,'len_quantum':1,'gap_quantum':1,'rate_num':10**6,'rate_den':1,'bucket_capacity':512,'initial_tokens':512,'pending_capacity':512,'lanes':4,'service':[10**6]*C,'fallback':0,'time_edges':[0],'count_edges':[0],'probability':[[65536]]}
model={'classes':C,'embedding_dim':E,'length_embedding':[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],'gap_embedding':[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(E)] for _ in range(16)],'kernel':K,'conv_weights':[[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(2*E)] for _ in range(K)] for _ in range(F)],'conv_bias':[r.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(F)],'conv_shift':[r.randrange(17) for _ in range(F)],'dense_weights':[[r.randint(-128,127) for _ in range(F)] for _ in range(C)],'dense_bias':[r.randint(-2**31,2**31-1) for _ in range(C)]}
conns=[{'id':f'c{i}','slot':i,'label':i%C,'split':'dev' if i%2 else 'eval'} for i in range(256)]
packets=[{'time':i*2,'connection':f'c{i%256}','length':r.randrange(65536),'draw':0} for i in range(20000)]
doc={'version':1,'config':cfg,'model':model,'connections':conns,'packets':packets}
with open('/app/stress.json','w') as f:json.dump(doc,f,separators=(',',':'))
PY
/usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed=%e cpu=%U maxrss=%MKiB stdout=%s bytes' -o /app/stress.time sh -c 'python3 /app/submission/main.py < /app/stress.json > /app/stress.out'
cat /app/stress.time
wc -c /app/stress.json /app/stress.out
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/app/stress.out') as f:d=json.load(f)
print('packets',len(d['packets']),'jobs',len(d['jobs']),'statuses',{s:sum(j['status']==s for j in d['jobs']) for s in ('applied','stale','superseded')})
PY
